title: Risk Assessment
description: Structured risk assessment with severity level, likelihood, impact scoring, and mitigation planning

likelihood.title: Likelihood
likelihood.description: Probability of occurrence (1 = very unlikely, 5 = almost certain)

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: Severity of impact if realised (1 = negligible, 5 = catastrophic)

mitigationPlan.title: Mitigation Plan
mitigationPlan.description: Planned actions to mitigate the identified risk

disclosure.recommendation: Risk assessments should be shared with governance and compliance participants. Mitigation plans may contain commercially sensitive strategies — restrict to decision-makers.
